title: sida rhombifolia subsp. retusa
intro: Sida rhombifolia subsp. retusa, commonly known as the buttonbush sida, is a perennial plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and rheumatism, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida rhombifolia subsp. retusa include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Further research is necessary to fully understand the efficacy and potential interactions of Sida rhombifolia subsp. retusa, but it has shown promise as a traditional medicinal plant.
